description:
Get the list of valid answers for a LOINC questionnaire item.

Use this tool to:
- Find valid response options for survey questions
- Get answer codes (LA…) for data entry validation
- Get the item scores of scored instruments (e.g. PHQ-9: "Not at all" = 0 … "Nearly every day" = 3)

Returns each answer with its LOINC answer code (LA…), text, display order and score (null when the list has none). A valid LOINC code without a defined answer list (e.g. a numeric lab such as 2339-0) returns an empty list; a code LOINC does not know returns a "not found" error.

Only applicable to LOINC codes that represent questions with defined answer sets. For the questions of a whole questionnaire, use loinc_panels; to find a code by name, use loinc_search.
name: loinc_answers

score.description: Numeric score for scored instruments (PHQ-9 items: 0-3); null when the answer list carries none.

sequence.description: Display order in the answer list (1-based).

attribution.description: Canonical source URLs of this response (attribution list)

provenance.description: Provenance block (contract v1.1): source, URL, data vintage, extraction instant, origin diagnostics, citation, license

data_vintage.description: Version/release of the data as exposed by the source; null when not exposed

license.description: License / legal regime of the data

anomalies.description: Anomalias superadas até o sucesso, somadas por classe, em ordem fixa; [] se nenhuma

kind.description: Classe da anomalia (vocabulário fechado do contrato)

attempts.description: Tentativas somadas, incluindo as repetidas (>= requests)

requests.description: Idas distintas à origem que compõem esta resposta (fatias, páginas)

unstable.description: true se houve repetição (attempts > requests) ou alguma anomalia

retrieval.description: Origin diagnostics of THIS source in this call (contract v1.1): requests made to the upstream, attempts summed across retries, anomalies worked around (kind + count); unstable=true when any anomaly happened. null when nothing was measured (bundled dataset, or response served entirely from cache)

retrieved_at.description: Real instant of the upstream extraction (ISO-8601, UTC). Responses served from cache keep the ORIGINAL fetch instant.

source.description: Official upstream source of this data

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the source (API base or dataset release)

title: LOINC Answer Lists
